commentary_title: Marginal uptick in Aframax utilisation while rates remained steady
commentary_summary: The share of laden vessels in both East and West regions increased last week, but due to the abundant availability of tonnage, rates did not increase last week despite a slight uptick in utilisation. | After 1Q24, the tonne-mile index remained lower than the last year throughout 2024 due to sluggish activity compared to 2023. The tonne-mile index reached 110.5 last week compared to 137.0 in the same period last year. | The rates in the US market are firming up and are anticipated to attract more vessels. Combined with the forecasted adverse weather conditions over the weekend, this could reduce tonnage availability, thereby supporting the rates.
